historical_lane: Expanded current-vintage prices on the same cases are retrospective diagnostics. Preserve the original SIM/LEARN exports and membership. Never label a new result on an examined 2020-2026 event as new validation.
learning_lane: Pre-2020 train/validation may be recomputed with admitted observations; training/selection cannot inspect later price or event outcomes. Lock a model and signal before prospective outcome collection. All changed historical results remain exploratory.
prospective_lane: Only events first recorded after registration and before outcomes may enter. Source event publication, local receipt and model/signal lock clocks are separate. No enrollment after its outcome window, retrospective backfill or test-set relabeling.
selection: Reuse LEARN-1 fixed candidates, train/validation cutoffs and cohort/episode embargo; no selection on old test returns. No threshold tuning in DATA-3.
costs: Reuse all SIM-1 declared, zero, stressed and flat-fee cost scenarios; fixed no-trade and same-window hold baselines. Unknown FX/actions/calendar remain blocked.
safety: Reference hypotheses only. No numerical probability, supported Buy, paper-account mutation, live order or broker connection. Original availability and executable product checks remain mandatory.
